**Avigdor Lieberman’s Briefing**

I don’t remember seeing this much nonsense published in the period between the elections and today.

337,413 citizens voted for Yisrael Beiteinu — almost 124,000 more than in the previous election.

Since the elections, I’ve met with all the key figures, both in the opposition and in the coalition.

No one was clearer than I was during the last election campaign. Unlike others, I don’t like vague language. Anyone who voted for Avigdor Lieberman knew exactly what they were voting for.

**Come hell or high water, I will not sit in a government with Netanyahu.** Even if he offers me the first term in a rotation agreement — it will not happen.

**The same goes for a minority government — it will not happen.**

We won’t drag things out. I’m trying to act fairly and responsibly.

I have many complaints about my partners in the opposition, but that has nothing to do with personal relationships.

To be absolutely clear, contrary to everything that was published about my meeting with Eisenkot, **I told him that we would recommend him.**

Regarding the position of Knesset Speaker, we have never engaged in political extortion.

Here too, as a matter of fairness, Yair Lapid told me that he wants the position, and **we will support his candidacy for Speaker of the Knesset.**
